# NLDesign

> NL Design is an open-source theming app for the Nextcloud workspace.

NL Design is an open-source theming app for the Nextcloud workspace. Administrators pick their organisation from a list of 39 pre-built themes (Rijkshuisstijl, Gemeente Utrecht, Amsterdam, Den Haag, Rotterdam, and more) and the workspace adopts that house style instantly. A token editor lets teams fine-tune individual colours, and customisations export to a file for sharing across instances. Released under EUPL-1.2 and maintained by Conduction since 2019.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://nldesign.conduction.nl/docs/intro): main entry, including tutorials, user guide, and admin guide.
- [API reference](https://nldesign.conduction.nl/api): OpenAPI documentation.

## Optional

- [Install](https://www.conduction.nl/install): self-host on your Nextcloud instance.
- [Source code](https://github.com/ConductionNL/nldesign): repository and issue tracker.
- [App page](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/nldesign): product positioning on conduction.nl.
